Selected work

Three projects, up close.

Personal project

Cogtics

Where did the revenue go?

A signed contract, a CRM deal, and a payment each tell part of the story. I built Cogtics to bring those records together and help find gaps between what a customer agreed to pay and what the business billed.

Inside the build

I built OAuth connections for HubSpot, Salesforce, PandaDoc, QuickBooks, and Stripe, with automated sync into Firestore. The app used Firebase authentication and interfaces built with Streamlit and Next.js. I completed local development and the product website.

View the project on GitHub ↗
Independent prototype

Site-Signal

Which locations actually changed?

Extracting and reviewing store locations takes time, even when a chain’s list looks exactly like last week’s. I built a prototype to check for changes before sending records through extraction again.

See the test results

I compared two consecutive weekly datasets. The prototype caught all 45 actual changes, correctly identified 109 unchanged cases, and flagged one extra case for review. Those figures measure the comparison logic on that sample. Live monitoring was still being validated.

View the project on GitHub ↗
Founding product engineer

Bidfast

What’s in an electrical drawing?

Contractors need to identify and count symbols before they can price a job. As Bidfast’s first technical hire, I built a takeoff MVP that reads construction PDFs and lets estimators review and correct the results.

Inside the build

I tested a fine-tuned YOLOv8n model alongside geometric matching. For vector PDFs, I used the coordinates already in the file to check a symbol’s shape and the arrangement of its parts. I built the review interface and APIs, deployed the product on AWS, and worked with the founder and early clients to decide what to change.
